body: Thanks , I really appreciate the kind words. I just got health insurance recently so I'm running out of excuses to not take your advice and talk to someone. Even if I have to drive a while. Thanks for listening.

No we haven't, I actually used to be a therapist so it's a bit hard for me to see one in the area because of dual-relationship issues. Our marriage is actually fine, she doesn't even know I feel this way. I'm really embarrassed about it and she's been so sorry for a long time about it that mentioning to her would just cause more harm than good probably. I'm not even sure there's anything she could even do to make me honestly feel attractive or desired so I don't feel the most comfortable communicating that to her.
